faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Call or WhatsApp us and an engineer will help.

items.q: How much subsidy can I get under PM Surya Ghar?
items.a: Residential homes get ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, up to a maximum of ₹78,000 for systems of 3 kW and above. Housing societies (RWA/GHS) get ₹18,000 per kW for common facilities. The subsidy is credited directly to your bank account after commissioning.

items.q: What size of system do I need?
items.a: A simple rule: every 1 kW generates about 120 units a month in Hyderabad. If your home uses 300–400 units a month, a 3 kW system usually covers it. Use our calculator above or book a free survey for an exact size.

items.q: How much does a rooftop solar system cost?
items.a: A typical 3 kW home system costs around ₹1.8–2.0 lakh before subsidy, and roughly ₹1.1–1.2 lakh after the ₹78,000 subsidy. Prices depend on panel brand, structure height and roof type.
Installation itself takes 1–3 days for most homes. Net-metering approval by the DISCOM usually takes 2–4 weeks; we follow up on it for you.

items.q: Will solar work at night or during a power cut?
items.a: Panels generate only in daylight. With an on-grid system, the extra power you export in the day offsets what you use at night through net-metering. On-grid systems switch off during a power cut for safety. If you want backup, choose a hybrid system with batteries.

items.q: How much space is needed on the roof?
items.a: About 70–90 sq. ft. of shadow-free area per kW. A 3 kW system needs roughly 250 sq. ft. Elevated structures let you keep using the terrace underneath.
Very little. Panels should be rinsed with water every 2–3 weeks to remove dust. We include periodic cleaning and health checks for the first 5 years.

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.intro: {{brand.legalName}} ("{{brand.name}}", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use this website or our solar services, why we collect it, who we share it with and the choices you have. It is written to comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable Indian laws.
highlights: We collect only what we need to prepare your solar quote and look after your system.
We never sell or rent your personal data.
We contact you only about your enquiry or your system, and you can opt out of offers at any time.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent.
The savings and EMI calculators run in your browser. Nothing you enter there is stored unless you send us an enquiry.
documents.contactText: For questions about this policy, or to exercise any of your rights, contact our Grievance Officer:

sections.title: Who we are
content: {{brand.legalName}} designs and installs rooftop solar power systems. For the personal data described here, we are the "Data Fiduciary" under the DPDP Act, 2023. Our office is at {{contact.address}}.

sections.title: Information we collect
content: **Information you give us**, for example when you fill in the enquiry form, message us on WhatsApp, call us or meet our team:

list: Your name, mobile number, email address and area / city.
Details about your requirement: property type, average monthly electricity bill and any message you send.
For a site survey and installation: your site address, roof measurements and photos, a copy of your electricity bill and your electricity consumer / service number.

If you ask us to apply for net-metering, the government subsidy or a solar loan on your behalf: the details those applications require, such as identity proof and the bank account where the subsidy is to be credited. We collect these only when you ask us to apply, and only what the application needs.

content: **Information collected automatically** when you visit the website: basic technical data such as browser type, device, pages visited and approximate location derived from your IP address, through our hosting provider and (if enabled) website analytics.
**What we don't collect:** we do not take payment card or net-banking details on this website, and we do not ask for sensitive information we don't need.

sections.title: How we use your information
content: We use your personal data only for these purposes:

list: Responding to your enquiry, scheduling a free site survey and preparing your proposal.
Designing, installing, testing and commissioning your solar system.
Applying for net-metering with your DISCOM and for government subsidies, when you ask us to.
Helping you apply for a solar loan with a lender you choose.
After-sales service: maintenance visits, monitoring support, warranty claims and service reminders.
Sending you offers or updates about our services, only if you have agreed, and you can opt out at any time.
Meeting legal, tax and accounting obligations, and protecting against fraud or misuse.
Understanding how visitors use the website so we can improve it (using aggregated data where possible).

sections.title: Your consent
content: When you submit an enquiry or share details with us, you consent to us using them for the purposes above. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us (see "Contact & grievances"). Withdrawal does not affect anything we did before it. We may still keep data we are legally required to keep, and we may be unable to continue a service that depends on that data.

sections.title: WhatsApp, calls and messages
content: If you choose to send your enquiry through WhatsApp, the message travels through WhatsApp (Meta), and WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies to that service. We will call, WhatsApp or SMS you only on the number you gave us, about your enquiry or your system. Promotional messages are sent only with your consent. Reply "STOP" or tell our team, and we will stop.

sections.title: Who we share it with
content: We **never sell or rent** your personal data. We share it only when needed to deliver your service or when the law requires it:

list: **Your electricity DISCOM** (e.g. TGSPDCL / TGNPDCL) to apply for net-metering and grid connection.
**Government portals** such as the PM Surya Ghar national portal / MNRE, to claim your subsidy.
**Banks and NBFCs**, only if you ask us to help with a solar loan.
**Equipment manufacturers**, to register product warranties in your name.
**Installation partners and technicians** working for us, under confidentiality obligations.
**Service providers** who help us run our business (website hosting, email, cloud storage, analytics), who may use your data only on our instructions.
**Authorities**, when required by law, court order or to protect rights and safety.

sections.title: Cookies and third-party content
content: The website may use essential cookies and, if enabled, analytics cookies to understand traffic. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Embedded content such as Google Maps and YouTube videos is served by those companies and may set their own cookies under their privacy policies. Some of these providers may process data outside India.

sections.title: How we protect your data
content: We use reasonable security safeguards: access is limited to staff and partners who need it, data is kept on secured systems and devices, and providers are chosen with appropriate safeguards. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, but if a personal data breach occurs we will inform affected users and the Data Protection Board of India as required by law.

list: **Enquiries that don't become orders:** up to 24 months after our last conversation, then deleted.
**Customers:** for as long as your system is under warranty or service with us, and afterwards only as long as tax and accounting laws require (generally up to 8 years).
**Website technical data:** kept in aggregated or anonymised form wherever possible.

sections.title: Your rights
content: Under the DPDP Act, 2023 you have the right to:

list: Get a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it.
Ask us to correct, complete or update inaccurate or incomplete data.
Ask us to erase data we no longer need, unless the law requires us to keep it.
Withdraw your consent and opt out of promotional messages.
Have your grievances addressed by us.
Nominate another person to exercise these rights on your behalf in case of death or incapacity.

content: To use any of these rights, contact our Grievance Officer (below). We may need to verify your identity first. We aim to respond within 7 working days, and in any case within the time required by law. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

sections.title: Children
content: Our services are meant for adults. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has shared data with us, please contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
content: We may update this policy when our services or the law change. The "Last updated" date at the top shows the latest version. For significant changes, we will make reasonable efforts to inform you.

sections.title: Using this website
content: You may use this website to learn about our services, estimate your savings and contact us. Please do not misuse it: do not attempt to disrupt it, gain unauthorised access, submit false information or use it for any unlawful purpose.

sections.title: Estimates are not quotes
content: The savings calculator, EMI calculator, energy-flow simulator and figures on this website are illustrative. They are based on average sunlight, typical tariffs and indicative prices. Actual system size, price, generation and savings depend on your roof, shading, consumption, tariff, equipment and government rules, and will be confirmed in a written proposal after a site survey.

sections.title: Quotes, orders and installation
content: A quote is valid for the period stated on it. An order is confirmed only when you accept our written proposal and pay the agreed advance. Installation timelines, payment milestones, warranties and service commitments are set out in that proposal/contract, which prevails over anything on this website.

sections.title: Government subsidy and net-metering
content: Subsidies (such as under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana) and net-metering are governed by government and DISCOM rules, which may change. Eligibility, amounts and timelines are decided by the relevant authorities. We will prepare and file applications on your behalf when you ask us to, but we cannot guarantee approval, amounts or processing time.

sections.title: Financing
content: Solar loans are provided by independent banks and NBFCs. Interest rates, eligibility, fees and repayment terms are decided by the lender. We may help you with the application but are not responsible for a lender's decision.

sections.title: Content and trademarks
content: The text, design, graphics and logo on this website belong to {{brand.legalName}} or are used with permission. Brand names of equipment manufacturers belong to their owners and are shown only to indicate products we install. Please do not copy or reuse our content without written permission.

sections.title: Third-party links and services
content: The website links to or embeds third-party services such as WhatsApp, Google Maps and YouTube. Their own terms and privacy policies apply, and we are not responsible for their content or availability.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
content: We take care to keep this website accurate and available, but it is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of the website or reliance on its estimates. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer protection law.

sections.title: Governing law
content: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Hyderabad, Telangana will have jurisdiction over any dispute relating to this website.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
content: We may update these terms from time to time. The "Last updated" date shows the latest version. Continuing to use the website after changes means you accept them.
